title: Where the encampment money went
subtitle: Shares of a 26-day city initiative; about $10,000 more went to disposal
alt: Bar chart of the shares the city of Austin reported for its Homeless Encampment Management initiative between May 11 and June 5, 2026: 62 percent of the cost went to staff salaries, 32 percent to contractors and 4 percent to equipment, with about 10,000 dollars more going to disposal
source: Austin Homeless Strategies and Operations, via KXAN
